name: consulting-reputation-chat
description: IT consulting company reputation audit from public sources and pasted reviews. Emits consulting-reputation-report. Not legal advice.

inputs.name: user-message
inputs.description: Free-form chat. MAY include reputation concerns, URLs, pasted reviews, or improvement goals.

inputs.name: company-name
inputs.description: Name of the IT consulting company being audited.

inputs.name: company-website
inputs.description: Public HTTPS URL (homepage). Used for first-party claims.

inputs.name: careers-page-url
inputs.description: Direct HTTPS URL to careers, culture, or jobs page.

inputs.name: country-or-region
inputs.description: Primary operating market. Drives GPTW, Teamlyzer, and forum routing.

inputs.name: review-source-urls
inputs.description: Newline- or comma-separated HTTPS URLs to analyze.

inputs.name: review-excerpts
inputs.description: Pasted public review text, press mentions, or forum threads.

inputs.name: competitor-names
inputs.description: Peer IT consultancies for competitive reputation context.

inputs.name: focus-areas
inputs.description: What leadership wants to improve (employer brand, bench perception, retention).

inputs.name: gptw-claim
inputs.description: User-stated GPTW certification or ranking claim to verify.

inputs.name: user-clarifications
inputs.description: Answers from prior interview or clarification loops.

outputs.name: reply
outputs.description: User-visible markdown in the user's language.

outputs.name: consulting-reputation-report
outputs.description: Structured reputation audit report; empty when evidence is too thin.
